title: Health checks, metrics and graceful shutdown

videos.script: boxoffice runs somewhere now, and something else decides when to start it, when to send it traffic and when to stop it. That something asks questions over HTTP. {{questions}} Two questions: is the process alive, and is it ready. A liveness check that tests the database restarts every copy at once. {{endpoints}} So healthz checks only the process, and readyz checks the database, on a port of its own. Stopping the database shows the difference, and a gap lesson thirteen left open. {{metrics}} Then metrics: counters, histograms and gauges, served for Prometheus, labelled by route and never by path. {{measure}} What to measure: rate, errors and duration, and why an average hides what a histogram keeps. {{shutdown}} Last, a graceful shutdown. Readiness turns off, new connections stop, streams are closed, and a slow purchase still in flight gets its answer before the process exits.
